details.hmac_signature: Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 signature verification over ${webhook-id}.${webhook-timestamp}.${rawBody} with v1, base64 or hex format and raw payload HMAC fallback using timing-safe comparison
details.replay_protection: Stale timestamp rejection (>300s window returning 400) and duplicate webhook-id deduplication (returning 200 ignored)
details.reaction_mapping: Tapback reactions mapped: like/thumbsup/approve/confirm/reaction.added:like => APPROVE (card ACTIVE, state AUTHORIZED); dislike/thumbsdown/reject/decline/reaction.added:dislike => REJECT (card LOCKED via lockVirtualCard, state DECLINED)
details.ledger_integration: Records state transitions atomically in Supabase Double-Entry Ledger via recordDoubleEntryLedger

details.search_query: POST /org/search with query string and max_results limit
details.evidence_fields: Parses content_id, title, chunk_text, score, source_url, total_results, processing_time_ms
details.fallback: Grounded policy evidence fallback for sandbox testing and offline operation
